label: Crypto & VASP Risk Assessment
description: ML/TF risk assessments for CASPs and VASPs aligned with FATF Recommendation 15, EBA Guidelines on crypto ML/TF risk factors, and FATF VA Guidance. Covers all crypto-specific risk dimensions: customer, product/service, geographic, transaction channel, DeFi exposure, NFT activity, and VASP due diligence scoring.

modelTier.notes: Risk assessments that understate residual risk create regulatory and legal exposure. Opus 4.7 strongly recommended.
